north_star.goal: Build a persistent seamless distributed world simulator where large-scale construction, terrain, matter, characters and multiplayer authority compose without duplicate truth layers.

current_goal_graph.title: H0.0 Restart-Safe Harness Scaffold
current_goal_graph.reason: Before touching runtime code, prove that the executable harness can load canonical contracts, build/reduce state, plan work, detect epoch invalidation and resume from Git-only fixtures.

current_goal_graph.title: H0.1 Closed-Loop C22 Pilot
current_goal_graph.reason: First autonomous pilot must prove restart-safe branch creation, constrained implementation, independent verification, PC0 audit and checkpoint proposal on a high-value but bounded Construction convergence task.

current_goal_graph.title: H0.2 High-Risk NX.C1 Pilot
current_goal_graph.reason: The second pilot proves the Harness on a post-R3 HIGH-risk owner-authority runtime frontier. Its runtime/source acceptance remains independent and requires exact runtime evidence plus CH->NX directional dependency revalidation.

current_goal_graph.title: V0-P4 Real-Resource Construction Closure
current_goal_graph.reason: P4 runtime is already implemented and frozen. The critical path is now control closure: prove current Project Control after live-frontier repair, integrate the append-only closure-ledger repair, record remaining predicates, and accept P4 before any P5 runtime dispatch.

current_goal_graph.title: V0-P5 Equipment and Tools
current_goal_graph.reason: Bind equipment/tool use to canonical items and existing command authority. P5 must branch from the exact accepted P4 product lineage, not from bare main and not from a historical Character donor branch.

current_goal_graph.title: V0-P6 Persistent Shared Outpost
current_goal_graph.reason: Create the first stable playable baseline containing mine -> inventory/container -> equipment/tool -> real-resource build -> disconnect/reconnect plus server-restart recovery and soak.

current_goal_graph.title: Post-P6 Seamless Insertion Decision
current_goal_graph.reason: P7 must not auto-start after P6. Main must explicitly activate V0-SM1 from the accepted P6 baseline or record a deliberate defer decision before P7 can be activated.

current_goal_graph.title: Construction convergence to real heterogeneous base
Playable persistent outpost product train
current_goal_graph.selection_rule: Only the current main-activated checkpoint is eligible for runtime dispatch. Future P checkpoints are plans, not dispatch permissions.

selection_rule: Choose the highest-value eligible checkpoint using scheduler policy. For V0/P, eligibility is sequential: close and accept the current P checkpoint, then main declares the exact accepted predecessor lineage as the next execution base, creates a fresh epoch/work order, rotates the single mutation lease, and only then may Director dispatch runtime mutation. Research frontiers are non-blocking unless an explicit registered dependency or a proven ownership/directional-watch intersection says otherwise.
